evidence.detail: The class owns maps from Client menu-row indices to callbacks and rs/j/b/a submenus plus one currently active submenu.
It inserts rows into the Client's parallel menu arrays, supports first/last/current insertion positions, binds callbacks and creates the exact default submenu title 'Choose Sub-Option'.
On menu-row hover/selection it activates the registered submenu when appropriate, invokes direct callbacks for bound rows and clears transient callback/submenu registries after dispatch.
Its static row-swap helper moves all five Client menu-action integer arrays, menu text and associated callback map entries together, proving ownership of dynamic menu extension/reordering.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 identity for the live dynamic menu submenu/callback coordinator.

evidence.detail: The class stores one submenu title, originating Client menu-row index, up to ten rs/j/b/b entries, computed width/height, screen x/y and currently hovered entry index.
Adding an entry creates one rs/j/b/b object from a String label plus rs/h/b callback and grows the submenu dimensions from exact client font metrics.
The class tests current mouse coordinates against the submenu rectangle and exposes the currently selected/hovered entry.
The class is referenced by Client, rs/j/b/d MenuSubOptionManager and multiple live plugin/UI consumers rather than being an isolated model.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 identity for one dynamic menu submenu and its layout/selection state.

evidence.detail: The class contains exactly a String label and one rs/h/b invokable callback, with getters/setters plus value equality/hash behavior and no unrelated state.
rs/j/b/a MenuSubOption constructs these entries exclusively when registering submenu labels/actions; exact rendering code consumes the same entry type.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 identity for one label/callback entry in a dynamic menu submenu.
